extra.summary: The Citi Cash Back Card is best for drivers and those with consistent dining and grocery expenses, offering up to 7.8% cashback on petrol/private transport and 5.8% on dining/groceries. However, you NEED to hit the S$800 minimum monthly spend to unlock these bonus rates; otherwise, you'll earn a mere 0.2%. Cashback is capped at S$80/month. Consider if your spending habits align with these categories and if you can consistently meet the minimum spend to maximize rewards.

our_takes.our-take: The Citi Cash Back Card is best for drivers and those with consistent dining and grocery expenses, offering up to 7.8% cashback on petrol/private transport and 5.8% on dining/groceries. However, you NEED to hit the S$800 minimum monthly spend to unlock these bonus rates; otherwise, you'll earn a mere 0.2%. Cashback is capped at S$80/month. Consider if your spending habits align with these categories and if you can consistently meet the minimum spend to maximize rewards.
our_takes.good-for:
Perfect for families who spend at least S$800 monthly and want cashback on groceries and petrol.
Ideal for frequent diners seeking to maximize rewards on restaurant spending, provided they meet the minimum monthly spend.
Suited for commuters who frequently use private transport and want to earn cashback on petrol and ride-hailing services.
our_takes.things-to-note:
Earning bonus cashback requires a minimum S$800 monthly spend; otherwise, you'll only receive the base 0.2% rate.
Cashback is capped at S$80 per month; spending beyond this limit won't yield additional rewards.
27.9% annual interest rate accrues if you don't fully repay your balance monthly, substantially increasing debt.
